name: vaulta-mark
description: Bookmarks Chrome doesn't know about. No omnibox autocomplete, opens in incognito, encrypted, optional sync via your Google Drive.
author: zyndata

scripts.verify:invariants: node scripts/verify-manifest.mjs && node scripts/verify-no-remote-code.mjs && node scripts/verify-strings.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run type-check && npm run test && npm run build && npm run verify:invariants && npm run check-budgets

//dependencies: Deliberately empty and staying that way (PLAN.md D4) — everything the extension needs is in the platform. A runtime dependency needs a written case and a bundle measurement. Dev dependencies are unrestricted.
